scope: Attendance only, 10000 employees, 20 ZKTeco SpeedFace V5L
reason: Managed restricted HTTP policy excludes vendor hosts; no general web search capability. No bypass attempted.
method: Read local source and existing v1.4.0 verification. Retrieved official Suprema G-SDK docs via enabled read-only GitHub tool.
vendor_capability_verdict: Comparison of functional scope and acceptance criteria; no vendor benchmark, price, capacity, license or release-specific certification.

acceptance.requirement: Connectivity without a fresh attendance record
acceptance.observable: Heartbeat/read refreshes last contact and visible device state, even with zero new punches
Responding device shows connected and read-only; no device writes
Virtual device shows simulated-connected in orange with text; actual device connectivity never fabricated
Initial snapshot includes records at 00:00 and before app startup; excludes previous day's 23:59:59 and next day's 00:00; late upload uses punch date
Employee identity and all 30/31 day columns on one paper width; every employee printed across vertical pages; readable text
